card.name: Digits inside large numbers and percentages
card.fires_on: Digits partway through a multi-digit number, often right before 'percent', 'pounds', 'times' or 'kilometers' in general web prose. Also a few direction words like 'directed' or 'and' before 'toward' or 'medialward' in anatomy text.

modes.label: Digits in quantities
modes.description: A leading or middle digit of a number that is followed by a unit or percent.
modes.example: Look for salt pork that is roughly 7<<5>> percent lean.

modes.label: Direction words in anatomy
modes.description: A word leading into a direction such as toward or medialward in anatomical description.
modes.example: the convexity of which is<< directed>> toward the right side.

card.writes: The promoted tokens (Web, Internet) and suppressed tokens (towards, upwards) show no clear link to the digit pattern.
card.plain: It fires on digits inside bigger numbers, such as the 5 in 75 percent, and sometimes on direction words in anatomy text.
